item.title: @elonmusk: Using Grok Bot to cancel services is pretty magical. It just figures it all out, on its own. I liter...
item.description: Using Grok Bot to cancel services is pretty magical. It just figures it all out, on its own. I literally had to ask it how it was able to cancel because I wanted to know. It couldn’t login to canceled so rather than getting stuck and asking me, it clicked a manage plan link in an email, got a one time sign in email sent, and then used that to cancel 😅 My bot is officially one step ahead of me.

item.title: @elonmusk: MrBeast says once enough airlines offer Starlink, he’ll only book those flights: “Extra layover? Don...
item.description: MrBeast says once enough airlines offer Starlink, he’ll only book those flights: “Extra layover? Don’t care—there’s Starlink. I’ll sit anywhere for it. Starlink is amazing.” He adds: “Most people haven’t used it, but in Antarctica it was our only signal. On a four-hour drive through rural Africa, we mounted Starlink on the car and had perfect connectivity the whole time.” On SpaceX: “What Elon Musk is doing will fundamentally advance humanity in unimaginable ways. Someone will go to Mars in our lifetime—I truly believe it.”

item.title: @elonmusk: Megatons to orbit & beyond is a critical piece of the K2 puzzle. The other parts are: massive amount...
item.description: Megatons to orbit & beyond is a critical piece of the K2 puzzle. The other parts are: massive amounts of solar cell production, AI chip production, millions of humanoid (general purpose) robots and a mass driver on the Moon. My guess is that ~1M Optimi plus ~1GW of solar will constitute the first Von Neumann Probe, a system capable of replicating itself entirely from local materials on any sufficiently large planet or moon. This would enable expansion of civilization throughout the galaxy and reaching K3.
